name: RotorX
summary:
Take control of the skies in ROTORX VR, a fast-paced VR drone racing experience built around precision flying, speed and challenging courses.

Choose your drone, select a track and put your piloting skills to the test against AI racers. Fly from an immersive FPV perspective or switch to a third-person view as you navigate race gates, sharp turns, elevation changes and demanding environments.
